sources.title: ATO: How to vary your PAYG instalments
sources.fact: Read by an agent on 24 September 2026 (page last updated 23 June 2026); not yet reviewed by a person. Vary by amount (option 1, T7) or rate (option 2, T2). Instalment income is gross business and investment income excluding GST. Quarterly amount: cumulative share of estimated tax for the quarter less instalments paid, plus any 5B credits claimed in earlier quarters (for example the fourth quarter is 100% of estimated tax less the first three instalments plus credits claimed in the second and third); a nil or negative result may give a credit at 5B. Varied rate is estimated tax divided by estimated instalment income times 100; where estimated instalment income is zero the amount or rate can be varied to zero. If varied instalments are less than 85% of total tax payable, GIC may apply to the difference, and penalties in some circumstances; no penalty or interest where reasonable care was taken.
